title: Sevilla day trips to Dehesa (Iberian Pig Farm) and Granada (Alhambra)
text: We took two excursions from Sevilla with Javier as our guide - one day to Dehesa and the pig farm and the other day to Granada and the Alhambra. Both days were excellent, very professional, personal, and fun. My two children (ages 12 and 14 / girl and boy) both enjoyed the trips - and keeping them both entertained with the same things can be a challenge as you might expect! I highly recommend this company and especially Javier - who also made some excellent flamenco and restaurant recommendations!
author: Voyager61021693071

title: Awesome day with some pigs and Alex and Martina!!!
text: Perfect day from start to finish. We started with extra time so stopped for coffee and a traditional toast breakfast. After we meet Martina to tour with the pigs and processing. She is very knowledgeable on the entire process and it was very interesting for us and our kids to learn so much. It’s also interesting to see the pigs. Alex picked a fantastic lunch spot and we were able to try some amazing dishes. After was the caves and they are so beautiful to walk through. Our whole family had a great day and learned a ton!
author: sjorisd
